transcript.text: A drawdown is a symptom of something
happening. There's one of two scenarios.
One is the market is shifted. And so
you're suffering losses because the
strategy, which is your go-to strategy,
is not performing as well in the current
market. There's an external variable,
which is the condition of the overall
market, and it is shifted, and now your
go-to strategy is not performing as well
as it used to. The second scenario is an
internal variable, which is that the
market is fine, but I'm no longer
centered. I'm emotional. I'm giving into
FOMO. I'm buying the top of moves. I'm
selling on the bottom of candle wicks.
And I'm just not in the zone. And the
market could be extremely strong, but
I'm screwing up and I'm losing money.
Unfortunately, sometimes both can happen
at the same time. And I would say that's
